useCachedData.description:
If enabled then generated {@link Data.Flow} will replace any previously computed sub-graphs with a
{@link Data.Flow.Cached} vertex.

doNotPreExecuteNonPandasActions.description:
If set, then the generated {@link Data.Flow} will not replace non-Data C3 actions producing Data. This must only be
used in retrieving the "representative" Data.Flow for Data.

dataset.description: The dataset in which to look for cached data. Used in conjunction with useCachedData

title: Specification for how to convert {@link Data} and related types to a {@link Data.Flow} in {@link Data#toDataFlow}
name: DataToFlowSpec
